import { Product } from '../domain/Product';
import { ProductRepository } from '../domain/ProductRepository';

const CATALOGUE: ReadonlyArray<{ id: string; name: string; stock: number }> = [
  { id: 'SKU-001', name: 'Espresso beans 1kg', stock: 50 },
  { id: 'SKU-002', name: 'Ceramic mug', stock: 120 },
  { id: 'SKU-003', name: 'Pour-over kettle', stock: 15 },
  { id: 'SKU-004', name: 'Burr grinder', stock: 8 },
];

export function seedCatalogue(products: ProductRepository): void {
  for (const item of CATALOGUE) {
    products.save(Product.create(item.id, item.name, item.stock));
  }
}
